Calculate the sea-level component of the ACI

Source: R/sealevel.R
sealevel_component.Rd

Calculate the sea-level component of the ACI

Usage

sealevel_component(
  country_abbrev,
  study_period,
  reference_period,
  mask_path = NULL,
  area = TRUE,
  max_dist_km = 500,
  sealevel_dir = NULL,
  admin_level = NULL,
  admin_assignment = NULL,
  crs_metric = 4326,
  computed_components = FALSE,
  save = FALSE,
  save_dir = NULL,
  load_dir = NULL
)

Arguments

country_abbrev

Three-letter country code (e.g. "FRA").

study_period

Character vector c("start", "end"). Required to filter and/or download PSMSL tide-gauge data (unlike ERA5-based components which read the full NetCDF file and filter in downstream steps).

reference_period

Character vector c("start", "end").

mask_path

Path to the country mask NetCDF. Used to extract the ERA5 grid when area = FALSE.

area

Logical. Mirrors the area argument of all other component functions: if FALSE (default), interpolates the standardised anomalies onto the ERA5 grid and returns a list with a [lon x lat x t] array — consistent with the grid-cell output of temperature_component(), precipitation_component(), etc. If TRUE, returns a data.frame of aggregated anomalies (national or per admin unit, depending on admin_level).

max_dist_km

Numeric. Maximum distance (km) for IDW interpolation. Only used when area = FALSE. Default 500.

sealevel_dir

Character or NULL. Path to the directory containing PSMSL .txt files. Named sealevel_dir for consistency with the sealevel_dir argument of calculate_aci(). If NULL or the directory does not exist, data are downloaded automatically.

admin_level

Integer or NULL. If not NULL, returns one column per admin unit. Ignored when admin_assignment is supplied.

admin_assignment

Output of assign_sealevel_to_admin(), or NULL. When supplied, takes precedence over admin_level.

crs_metric

EPSG code used when building admin_assignment internally. Default 4326.

computed_components

Logical. If TRUE, reloads a previously saved .rds file from load_dir. Default FALSE.

save

Logical. If TRUE, saves the processed result to save_dir. Default FALSE.

save_dir

Character. Directory for saving results. Default NULL, which resolves to a sub-directory of tempdir().

load_dir

Character. Directory from which to reload a cached result when computed_components = TRUE. Default NULL, which resolves to a sub-directory of tempdir().

Value

If area = FALSE: a list with a [lon x lat x t] array, lon, lat, time — same structure as other grid-cell components. If area = TRUE: a data.frame of station anomalies (national or per admin unit).
